headline: Big Banks Stocks Rallied After Finance Minister Change, Now Under Pressure Again: Here's the Outlook
summary: Big bank stocks in Indonesia fell again after briefly strengthening following a finance minister change. Credit and profit fundamentals and the direction of fiscal policy are now in focus for investors.
why: Large state and private banks make up a major share of Indonesia's stock market and reflect expectations for credit growth and fiscal policy. Changes in finance ministers can shift investor views on budget direction.
